item.text: {"analysis":"The candidate executed successfully but failed to improve validation HR@10: 0.630 versus the parent's 0.650, a decrease of 0.020 (four hits at the stated 0.005-per-hit resolution). The host completed 30 epochs and selected epoch 10. Reject this candidate and retain the parent. Zero-initialized gate parameters make the initial multiplier exactly one, but context-dependent gating did not improve this run. The result does not establish why performance declined; expanding conv1 also changes random-number consumption and subsequent initialization. No test metric was provided or consulted.","code_summary":"One causal NextItNet with MAXLEN=128, hidden width 64, eight residual blocks, kernel size 3, dropout 0.2, and dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block uses pre-convolution LayerNorm, a doubled-output first convolution split into features and gates, GELU(features) multiplied by 2*sigmoid(gates), dropout, then LayerNorm and a second causal convolution. Per-channel learned residual scales start at 0.1. The model retains item and positional embeddings, padding masks after every block, final LayerNorm, last-nonpadding candidate selection, and tied item-embedding scoring. LR=0.001, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.0, BATCH_SIZE=128; training and evaluation remain host-owned."}
